## Corrective Measures

```go
// Use sync.RWMutex for read-heavy workloads
mu sync.RWMutex

// Stats: use atomic operations
atomic.AddInt64(&c.stats.Hits, 1)

// ALL map access must hold lock
func (c *Cache) Set(key string, value interface{}) {
    c.mu.Lock()
    defer c.mu.Unlock()
    c.data[key] = &CacheEntry{...}
}

// GetMulti: use WaitGroup and mutex for results
var wg sync.WaitGroup
var resultsMu sync.Mutex
for _, key := range keys {
    wg.Add(1)
    go func(k string) {
        defer wg.Done()
        value, err := c.Get(ctx, k)
        if err == nil {
            resultsMu.Lock()
            results[k] = value
            resultsMu.Unlock()
        }
    }(key)
}
wg.Wait()

// waitForLoad: use sync.Cond or channel, not busy-wait
```
